description: Trim reqwest features: default-features=false + rustls/system-proxy/json/blocking. description: Stability confirmation (no code change, post-trim commit 1789558): check_seconds=0.111, 0.108 via harness. description: Tested the last untested LTO dimension: fat lto=true + codegen-units=16 (was cgu=1). HYPOTHESIS FALSE: binary_kb 1996 → 2028 KB (+32 KB, size WORSE) and build_seconds 12.75s vs 8.22s (slower). Under fat LTO, codegen-unit fragmentation is NOT re-optimized away at link time — more bitcode modules make the fat-LTO merge + machine-outliner phase slower AND less effective (fragmented modules reduce cross-unit outlining/DCE). Independently re-confirms exp #19 (cgu=1 essential). Checks passed but primary regressed → revert to cgu=1. binary_kb floor 1996 KB re-confirmed.

asi.hypothesis: Fat LTO merges all codegen units into one module before optimization, so codegen-units=16 should give parallel crate codegen (faster build) at identical binary size.
asi.result: FALSE — fat LTO + cgu=16 = 2028 KB (+32 KB) and 12.75s build (slower than cgu=1's 8.22s). Fragmentation survives fat-LTO merge; outliner/DCE less effective on fragmented modules.
asi.rollback_reason: Primary metric binary_kb regressed 1996 → 2028 KB (+32 KB); build also slower. No in-scope reason to keep.
asi.next_action_hint: codegen-units=1 definitively optimal (now verified under BOTH thin-LTO comparison exp #19 and direct fat-LTO A/B). Last untested LTO dimension closed. binary_kb floor 1996 KB stands; no in-scope lever remains.
asi.finding: Under fat LTO, cgu=1 is not just optimal for size but also faster to build than cgu=16 (fewer bitcode modules to merge in the LTO phase).

description: build-std LIVE PROBE — hypothesis FALSIFIED, lever definitively closed. Safely probed -Z build-std feasibility (RUSTC_BOOTSTRAP=1, nonexistent-target trick to avoid any build): (1) cargo 1.98 stable ACCEPTS -Z build-std with RUSTC_BOOTSTRAP=1 — the recorded 'needs nightly install' blocker was WRONG, no rustup/nightly needed. (2) The REAL blocker is environmental: nix sysroot std source declares wasip1 as an external crates.io dep; wasip1 is NOT cached locally and NOT in Cargo.lock. (3) crates.io unreachable from this environment (persistent SSL connect error 0A000126 unexpected eof, 3 tries/attempt across multiple online attempts; offline also fails 'no matching package named wasip1'). Conclusion: build-std cannot execute here at all — std source tree unresolvable without crates.io. Config (temporary [unstable] build-std + RUSTC_BOOTSTRAP env) fully reverted via git checkout; tree clean; binary_kb floor 1996 KB re-confirmed after restore (build_seconds 15.24 = deps rebuilt against normal std), checks pass. This was the LAST untested lever. binary_kb thread now exhaustively closed: all in-scope dimensions A/B-verified + every out-of-scope path tested and blocked (TLS swap=deps, async reqwest=arch, build-std=network).
